changes.anchor: ## Retained consequence can exceed current evaluative use
changes.addition:
## Acquired tests become operative in further inquiry

The [discrimination continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/DISCRIMINATION-REVISION-INTEGRATION.md) tests a particular connection in the original observation-table learner. Acquired prediction failure leads it to retain a continuation that separates histories with equal present outputs. Existing proofs already show why that distinction is necessary for an exact representation of their future behavior; no new learning theorem is claimed.

From the same post-write checkpoint, ordinary use of the acquired context produces four fresh endpoint requests and separates the empty history from the one-action history. An external intervention preserves the stored context and its prior expenditure while making the next table reader use its old view. The requests and separation disappear at that step. This is evidence of the acquired context's operative role, rather than merely its presence in a record. The diagnostic branch stops after one table; it is not a completed alternative learning history or a new internally available revision operation.

The original thirty-six-unit binary run still fails. A separately provisioned mathematical assay completes the unchanged all-word prediction contract and retained use. The latter cannot finance or replace the earlier failed history. At final compaction the learner retains its model but discards the diagnostic table, so persistent renewed-inquiry capacity is not established by that run.

This change of acquired discrimination and the separate [actual inquiry-limit rewrite](INQUIRY-REVISION.md) identify different ways consequences revise operative inquiry. A fixed encompassing law can implement both. The broader question concerns how the undertaking's scope, its relevant outcomes and its requirements are acquired or revised through effects on continuing activity. These implementations preserve that explanatory obligation without treating the learning organization and its consequences as fundamentally independent starting points.
